title: Turn Any Folder Into a Local Website
description: Use Python's built-in HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 for a localhost-only preview, with an explicit note about deliberate LAN access.
hook: This folder can become a localhost-only website with one command.

scenes.headline: YOUR FOLDER. NOW A SITE.
scenes.narration: One command turns this folder into a local website. Here is the result.
scenes.caption: The result, before the explanation.

scenes.headline: BIND IT TO LOCALHOST
scenes.narration: Run this in a harmless folder. The bind flag keeps it on this machine.
scenes.caption: Bind explicitly to localhost.

scenes.headline: CLICK. RESULT.
scenes.narration: Open localhost colon eight thousand. Click the button. The result comes from the actual served files.
scenes.caption: A real click. A real response.

scenes.headline: LOCAL IS NOT LAN
scenes.narration: Remove the bind only for deliberate LAN access. Otherwise, keep your files to yourself.
scenes.caption: LAN access should be deliberate.

scenes.headline: DONE? CONTROL C.
scenes.narration: Control C stops it. Software that leaves when asked. Remarkable.
scenes.caption: Start locally. Stop cleanly.
